rationale_short: The report records eight recordable injuries in FY25, which conflicts with the claim that everyone returns home healthy and safe every day.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is a broad workplace safety outcome/assurance (“everyone returns home healthy and safe every day”). The only provided evidence is an extracted value of “8” recordable injuries (with metric name listing other safety metrics but no values for them). This does not substantively verify that everyone returns home healthy and safe every day; in fact, reporting 8 recordable injuries indicates incidents occurred. The evidence also lacks timeframe, scope, workforce coverage, and any data on LTIFR, fatalities, or work-related ill-health needed to support the claim’s universal, everyday safety outcome.
